authorship_evidence: Generated by GPT-5.5 for the RealVuln vibe-coding benchmark, then seeded with approved v2-campaign-1, v2-campaign-2, v2-campaign-3 vulnerabilities.

evidence.description: Pulse-style route returns raw exception details to the caller. Seeded during v2-campaign-1 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Wire-style route writes sensitive request data to application logs without redaction. Seeded during v2-campaign-1 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
After-lane route sends the caller to a caller-controlled destination without validation. Seeded during v2-campaign-1 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Domain workflow accepts an invalid state or amount without enforcing the business rule. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Bundle restore operation deserializes caller-controlled bytes with an unsafe API. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Vault-style export writes sensitive business data to local storage without encryption. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Formula preview evaluates caller-controlled expressions as runtime code. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Portal marker cookie is set without the expected security flags. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Relay probe opens a caller-supplied endpoint server-side without host validation. Seeded during v2-campaign-2 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Identity hint flow returns distinct messages for unknown handles and invalid verifier values. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Origin mirror reflects arbitrary request origins while allowing credentials. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Frame slip response explicitly disables or clears browser security headers. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Jinja cast builds and renders a template string from caller-controlled text. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Dock shelf writes caller-provided file content and names without type, extension, or size validation. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Nonce roll generates security-sensitive verifier material with Python's non-cryptographic random module. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
XML fold parses caller-provided XML with external entity and DTD resolution enabled. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Badge gate trusts a caller-controlled marker to reveal elevated operational data. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Mongo lane passes caller-controlled JSON directly into a NoSQL query filter. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
Trust drift operation disables peer verification for an outbound partner check. Seeded during v2-campaign-3 and approved for RealVuln GT enhancement.
False-positive trap: this helper enforces the internal operations token before seeded routes run, so the guard itself is not a missing-authentication vulnerability.

Resembles SQL injection because the user-supplied query parameter q (request.GET.get('q')) is fed straight into a database filter. It is actually safe: it uses the Django ORM QuerySet.filter with __icontains lookups (Q(user__first_name__icontains=q) | ...). The ORM builds a parameterized SQL query and binds q as a bound parameter, never string-interpolating it into the SQL text, so no injection is possible. The other filters (status, department_id) are also ORM-parameterized.

Resembles insecure random for a security-sensitive value: it generates a temporary account password (password = get_random_string(16)) used to create a real user account. It is actually safe because get_random_string is imported from django.utils.crypto (see line 12), which is backed by Python's secrets/SystemRandom CSPRNG, not the non-cryptographic random module. A scanner keying on 'random' + 'password' may flag it, but the source is cryptographically secure.

Resembles a missing-authorization / mass-data-exposure JSON endpoint that dumps all employees. It is actually safe: the view is @login_required, it explicitly calls require_role(request.user, HR_ADMIN, MANAGER, PAYROLL) which raises PermissionDenied for unauthorized roles, and the data it serializes comes from visible_employees(request.user), which tenant-scopes the queryset (managers only see themselves and direct reports; employees only themselves). There is no user-controlled object id, so no IDOR and no unauthorized disclosure.
The Django SECRET_KEY falls back to the known literal dev-only-change-me. A deployment without DJANGO_SECRET_KEY uses a public signing key for Django signing-dependent features and security tokens.
DJANGO_DEBUG defaults to enabled. Default deployments can expose Django debug pages and this also enables direct MEDIA_ROOT serving in the URL configuration.

With DEBUG enabled by default, Django serves MEDIA_ROOT directly at /media/. HR documents and onboarding evidence are intended to pass through document_download authorization, but known or leaked media paths bypass that check.
Session and CSRF cookies are configured as HttpOnly but SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE, HSTS, and HTTPS redirect are absent, leaving auth cookies sendable over HTTP.
The public login route mounts Django LoginView directly and the project has no rate-limit, lockout, or throttling middleware, enabling automated credential stuffing against account login.
The public password-reset request route uses Django PasswordResetView without per-account or per-IP throttling, allowing reset-email abuse and account-recovery automation.

The normal HR-admin CSV import route assigns every newly imported user the same hard-coded password ChangeMe123! and does not force a reset in the created profile. Anyone who knows or guesses the default can log in as imported accounts until changed.

Any authenticated manager can POST the reject action for a guessed compensation request id because the reject branch checks only role and status, unlike manager approval which verifies the request belongs to a direct report.

The payroll list view limits payroll users to HR-approved or effective compensation requests, but compensation_detail permits any payroll user to access any compensation request id, including draft, submitted, rejected, or unrelated salary details.
Payroll specialists can access all HR requests and receive HRRequestAdminForm, allowing them to update status and assignee outside payroll-specific duties and across all employees.

Internal HR comments are filtered only for employees. Managers viewing direct-report requests and payroll specialists viewing requests receive comments marked internal, exposing HR-only discussion outside the intended audience.

Policy.audience defines HR, manager, payroll, and all-employee audiences, but policy_list returns every active policy to every authenticated user and policy_ack accepts any active policy id. Employees can view and acknowledge role-restricted policies.

Employee detail renders every document title, category, and download link from employee.documents.all without applying can_view_document. Managers and payroll users who can open an employee page can enumerate document metadata outside their document permissions even when download is later denied.

Authenticated employees can upload onboarding evidence through EvidenceForm, which exposes the FileField without size, extension, MIME, or content validation. Under default media serving, arbitrary uploaded content is stored under same-origin media and large uploads can consume storage.

HR document uploads enforce only a 10 MB size limit and do not validate extension, MIME type, or file content before storing payslips, tax forms, contracts, or policy acknowledgements in media storage.

Employee-controlled profile names and HR-controlled policy/task text are written directly into CSV exports without neutralizing spreadsheet formula prefixes. Opening exported reports can execute formulas beginning with =, +, -, or @.

EmployeeImportForm reads the uploaded CSV into a full list of rows and import_employees processes every row without a file size, row count, or batching limit. Large imports can consume memory and create unbounded database work.

Payslips, tax forms, contracts, policy acknowledgements, and onboarding evidence are stored as ordinary local media files without application-level encryption. Filesystem or backup disclosure exposes payroll and HR documents in plaintext.

Integration API keys are generated as bearer secrets, stored in plaintext, and rendered back in full on the integrations page. Database, backup, or admin page exposure reveals reusable integration credentials.
The internal vault route uses caller-controlled ref to build a filesystem path before writing JSON. Path traversal sequences can move the write outside the intended export directory.
